title: 2026 Fiesta Bowl: How to Watch Miami vs. Ole Miss College Playoff Game Online for Free
summary: The Fiesta Bowl kicks off on Jan. 8 at 7:30 p.m. ET.

The College Football Playoffs have made its way into the semifinals today with a hard-hitting matchup between No. 10 Miami Hurricanes and No. 6 Ole Miss Rebels in the 2026 Fiesta Bowl. After taking out college football juggernauts Ohio State, Miami is now only two wins away from their first national title since 1960. However, after defeating No. 3 Georgia in the Sugar Bowl, Ole Miss has plenty of momentum entering today’s game. This will be the schools first meeting since 1951.

The 2026 Fiesta Bowl, at a Glance:

- Where: State Farm Stadium, Glendale, AZ

- Time: 7:30 p.m. ET

- Broadcast: ESPN

- Stream: DirecTV , Fubo , ESPN Unlimited , Sling TV , Hulu + Live TV

Looking for a great way to watch the 2026 Fiesta Bowl online? We’ve created a full guide on where to stream the Miami vs. Ole Miss game online without cable and for free. Keep reading on to learn more.
